title: Itching powder in Tizol's shirt
summary: Bigard and Hodges got revenge by dusting Tizol's shirt sleeve with itching powder, so he left the stand and gave up pranks.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: So Johnny and I, we said, "We're going

to fix him." So we went by that little store and we got some itching powder. We used to wear tuxedos, you know. We had nice gray tuxedos and a tuxedo shirt, you know, the bosom. And we would hang them up in the room.
So we got to Tizol's room. We came early in the morning and we powdered underneath the arm of his shirt sleeve.

Gave him a good powdering too, you know. So nobody said nothing. The show went on. The klieg lights hit him, and the first thing we saw him moving. (unintelligible) Couldn't believe it... So he kept on -- it's getting worse now. He's moving more and more and finally it got so he couldn't stand it anymore and he got off the stand. He just left everything. And everybody had a straight face. They didn't know what happened, you know. The rest of them knew what happened but they didn't know who did it.
And he was cussing and raving when we got off the stand. That cured him from playing pranks.
Yeah, but he couldn't take it, though, you see. That was the bad part about it. Well, we cured him. So that was -- we used to do a lot of things, funny things. We had a lot of fun.
